evidence_kind: exact geometry of the retained model and retained float32 asset comparison; source evidence, not renderer performance evidence

sticker_comparison.explanation: build_assets.py uses ConvexHull of floating region points. The retained triangle soup contains extra points besides the exact host vertices, repeated triangles and triangles whose corners collapse at float32 precision. It is not a minimal triangulation of the exact host polyhedron. Raw 1e-9 vertex matching also counts float32 rounding error; the separately reported float32-rounded reference separates that error from extra stored points. Counts do not reconstruct the unavailable pre-float32 hull inputs. Near-coincident points are distinct stored points within 1e-9 of one float32-rounded exact vertex (an exact zero coordinate stored as a tiny nonzero value); each adds hull points and triangles. unattributed_stickers lists the stickers with more triangles than the exact count that none of these counts explains.
